description: Control an iOS Simulator (macOS): list, boot (binds it to the session), install (.app), launch, terminate, openurl, logs, privacy_reset, erase (wipes it). install, privacy_reset and erase are consent-gated. A slow cold boot returns status:"booting" (poll qa_wait for:"simulator_booted"). Structured iOS automation: qa_wda.

device.description: boot/erase: simulator UDID or exact name (other actions: the bound one only).

service.description: privacy_reset: service, e.g. location, photos, all.
